policy.regression: OLS with intercept on the 252 paired daily log returns immediately before the latest completed return; current return excluded. Population covariance/variance sums; beta=cross_sum/benchmark_sum_squares; alpha=mean(symbol_return)-beta*mean(SPY_return).
policy.residual: For this evaluation, e_i=log(symbol_close_i/symbol_close_i-1)-alpha-beta*log(SPY_close_i/SPY_close_i-1), using the one prior-only fitted alpha/beta for all supplied residual history. Inputs are only through the latest completed close. Reconstructed past residuals are not historical point-in-time observations.
policy.residual_z: Sum of latest 5 residual log returns divided by prior-252 residual daily population SD times sqrt(5). Prior sigma uses the 252 returns used to fit beta; current return excluded from sigma.
policy.trend_z: Sum of latest 63 residual log returns divided by the same prior-252 residual daily population SD times sqrt(63).
policy.vol_regime: Population z-score of latest 21-residual-return RMS versus 252 preceding rolling 21-return RMS values. Current RMS excluded from baseline; RMS=sqrt(sum(e_i^2)/21).
policy.hurst: R/S slope from OLS of log(block size) against log(mean block R/S), sizes 8,16,32,64, using non-overlapping blocks anchored at the first of the latest 252 residual log returns. Within each block subtract its arithmetic mean, cumulatively sum centered values, R is max(cumulative)-min(cumulative), S is sample standard deviation (ddof=1), and average R/S across complete blocks. Require the resulting exponent to be in [0,1]; never clip.
policy.windows: All lookbacks are in official completed US-equity sessions. Returns use close-to-close natural-log price changes. The current residual return is available only after the completed-session delay.
policy.units: residual_z and trend_z are dimensionless z-scaled log-return sums; hurst is a dimensionless R/S exponent; vol_regime is a dimensionless z-score. No percent conversion, annualization, dividend adjustment, imputation, or feature clipping.
policy.degeneracy: Reject non-finite intermediates and any OLS denominator, residual population SD, R/S block SD, R/S average or volatility normalizer <=1e-12. No variance floor.
policy.price_basis: Split-adjusted, dividend-excluded provider prices. IEX is one exchange, not consolidated SIP; provider revisions and historical availability remain unverified.
policy.zero_missing: Require 505 exact paired official-session bars per symbol on the same dates. No forward fill, skipped bars, substituted ticker, or alternate benchmark.
policy.forecast_interpretation: Unchanged fixed FE02 scorer applied to NEW measurements; research-only uncalibrated signed score, not a residual-return magnitude, probability, edge or trade admission.
policy.session_currency: Latest completed session in a fresh complete official-provider calendar response through the current New York date; close+15min must be <= actual evaluation. Every selected paired session is required; no older-window substitution.
policy.original_age_semantics: The original catalog48h maximum is unchanged and reported independently. Exceeding it does not satisfy the original input contract; V2 only permits descriptive research when the complete latest official-returned session grid is present.
policy.extended_closure_guard: If the latest returned completed close is older than7calendar days, abstain extended_closure_or_calendar_staleness_unverified. This sanity/review boundary is not an observation-freshness claim or a replacement for the original48h rule.
policy.acquisition_currency: All actual acquisition request starts and receipts must be within25s before evaluation; calendar completes before history starts. Same original response/page/rate budgets. Source observation clocks are never replaced by retrieval time.
policy.cache: Successful results only, at most60s from evaluation; expire at next eligible-session boundary, New York midnight, original48h threshold if future, or7day guard. Delivery age is separate; original source/evaluation/receipt clocks are immutable.

hash_rules.source_files: SHA256 checked-in UTF-8/LF bytes; generated bundle digest excluded

rollback: Frozen corrected V1 builder/producer/manifest retained unchanged. Restore V1 build selection and matching UI schema/hash together. V2 changes source-session research availability only, never original catalog48h age or trading eligibility.
